arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)
for ws in wb.worksheets:
    print('SHEET:', ws.title)
    for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
        print(row)
"
